The '''Mynock II virus''' was a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] modified by [[Faerz Waleth]] of [[Nebula Consumables]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was modified from the original [[Mynock virus]], and used to infect [[Gryseium Incorporated]]'s facilities on [[Sprawl 18]] of the planet [[Tyed Kant]]. This both ended the threat of the Mynock virus, and wreaked revenge on that virus's designers.<ref name="MC" />
